senses.gloss: to mix with all sorts of things, to mix indiscriminately. Part. pass. בָּלוּס, f. בְּלוּסָה.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 76b">Sabb. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>עיסה ב׳</he> a dough of unsifted flour (with bran &c.).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:2">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>אוצר ב׳</he> a store room of mixed things (lumber room).—
<cite ref="Gittin 67a:8">Gitt. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>אוצר ב׳</he> a mind full of all kind of knowledge (oth. vers. <he>בלום</he>, v. <cite ref="B00881"><he>בָּלַם</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>בְּלוּסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:5">Mikv. IX, 5</cite> <he>הב׳</he> utensils soaked with a mixture of colors (stains from use), opp. <he>נקיים</he> shining, polished.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28:4">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>אוצרות בְּלוּסִים</he> store of spoiled fruits.
